# Fixtures for `berkeley_db` (Berkeley DB database)

Every file here was made for whiff's tests and is released under CC0-1.0, for a fictitious harbour (Saltmere Harbour): made with db5.3_load. Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/db.sh`.
